scenes.script:
Priya says: I am having a doubt.
Miss Nova says: Boliye, 'I have a doubt'. Main aapko bolte hue sunti hoon aur live correct karti hoon.
Priya says: I didn't knew that.
Miss Nova says: Boliye, 'I didn't know that'. 'did' ke saath humesha root verb use hota hai.
Priya says: You teach very nice.
Miss Nova says: Boliye, 'You teach very well'. Aap English bolkar hi seekhte ho, bilkul apni Hindi ki tarah.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The translation successfully applies the 'Teaching / correction skit' register module. It keeps all quoted English lines verbatim per T2a, applies the Hindi language module rules, maintains polite address for Miss Nova ('karein', 'kijiye'), and localizes the mother-tongue reference to 'Hindi' per T5. The tone is highly colloquial, natural, and free of formal Sanskritized words.
